sentences.text:
Through :- Mr. N.D. Qazi, Advocate.
 V/s
Ut of J&K & Ors.

Through :-
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M A Chowdhary, Judge
 Order

1. Petitioners through the medium of this petition seek direction to the respondents to initiate and finalize the process of acquisition in respect of the land of the petitioners falling under Khasra Nos.
590/372, 540, 589/373, 641/543, 171, 534 and 45/46 situate at Channa-A (Kotli), Tehsil Chassana,
District Reasi in accordance with Principles of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013, alleging that the land of the petitioners has been used by the respondents for construction of road from Sungri to Channa via Kotli.

2. Heard.
3. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable within three weeks.
Requisite steps to be furnished within one week.

(M A Chowdhary) Judge Jammu 10.05.2023 Ram Krishan Kousar Niazi & Ors vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 10 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14438972/
